findings.description: Unavailable typed motion context becomes a clean result. shape accepts a null dimension, and W1 checks only whether the contexts list is empty or contains the literal motion_plausibility dimension. A present observation with dimension=null satisfies neither condition. Independently queried an in-memory SQLite dataset containing matching media, decoded timeline, sampled-frame evidence and corrected record hashes: null and invalid dimensions each returned COMPLETE, ready=true, findings=[], unknown=[]. The valid motion dimension produced W1. Thus unavailable context is treated as successful evaluation.

E3 treats the existence of a metadata object as an available decoded timeline without validating its duration. For full-clip evidence with no explicit interval or samples, the comparisons never execute. Independently queried a retained TEST-ONLY graph after replacing metadata.duration_seconds with null, then an invalid string, and updating its digest. Both queries returned COMPLETE, ready=true, findings=[], unknown=[]. The promised unavailable-timeline boundary is bypassed.
